subject: Evening Inference Sprint — waitlist, host coverage, and bridge plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@tellus.ai>, Marta Alvarez <marta@tellus.ai>, Rajesh Iyer <raj.iyer@astralogistics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evening Inference Sprint — office hours (EMEA/APAC-friendly)

Hi all —

Thanks for signing up for the Evening Inference Sprint office hours next week. We designed this slot to be friendly to EMEA/APAC teams who can’t make daytime sessions. Quick notes: 

- Time: Thu, 27 May • 18:00–19:00 BST (bridge included)
- Format: 20m demo, 25m Q&A + live troubleshooting, 15m open office-hours for specific infra questions
- Capacity: 25 seats; we’ll keep a short waitlist and a live overflow policy if more people show up

If you can share the top 2 things you want us to cover (e.g., latency tuning, private deployment, Dedicated sizing), reply to this thread — that helps us prioritize.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=xyz-evening-sprint
[Attachment: evening-sprint-agenda.pdf]

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Thanks, Neha — this looks great. I registered and added my manager Marta as well. For Tellus, the two areas we most want: (1) best practices for KV caching across bursty workloads, and (2) model selection guidance for cost/latency tradeoffs.

One question — if the session hits capacity, will people on the waitlist be able to dial into the same bridge (audio-only) or do you open a second livestream?

— Linda

Is there any chance you’ll keep the bridge open for an extra 20–30 minutes for late joiners, or should I plan to catch the recording? From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal — evening sprint waitlist + host coverage plan

Vivek / Ben —

Quick operational note for Thursday’s Evening Sprint: demand exceeded the 25-seat cap and we have ~12 waitlisted participants (mix of EMEA/APAC). Main asks we’ve seen so far: KV caching, Dedicated autoscaling, model/quantization tradeoffs. Attached attendee list and agenda.

Proposed plan:
- Ben: you lead the 20m demo (covers routing, batching, cache recommendations).
- Vivek: you own the deep-dive Q&A + autoscaling examples. If a late SRE joins (e.g., Raj at 19:30 GMT+5:30), we keep the bridge open and add them to the live audio; if too many late joiners arrive we’ll open a second listen-only YouTube link.
- I’ll run the waitlist and triage chat questions; I’ll paste the attendee roster into the bridge chat and bump high-priority customers into the call.

Please confirm you can cover those segments. Also confirm you have time to join the pre-brief 30 minutes before (17:30 BST).

[Attachment: initial-attendee-list.csv]

Thanks,
Neha

One small ask: can we publish a single canonical follow-up doc after the session (short summary + top 3 configs) that I can share with waitlist folks even if they didn’t get live audio? Happy to draft post-session.
